scope: Proposition 5.2 (Simultaneously sampled symbols) of the manuscript “A torsion-free counterexample to reduced Baum–Connes injectivity” (preprints/A-Torsion-Free-Counterexample-to-Reduced-Baum-Connes-Injectivity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 285 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df8d9301aa6d0306), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 41-42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix b, a finite matrix dimension, a positive accuracy η, and a finite list of compact smooth symbol profiles and height selections as above. The list may include cutoffs, both parities, the initial-height selection, and any finite mesh of the adjacent rescaling and rotation families. Allocate a prescribed incidence type for every required same or adjacent layer symbol. For sufficiently large s and then sufficiently large initial height, the surviving base graph admits a voltage on every edge and finite-net matrix weights such that the following hold simultaneously. 41 1. The voltage cover has no nontrivial cyclically reduced closed walk of length at most 6.03mi based at an old vertex of height i. 2. All weighted blocks may use the common denominator q. If Vτ,ik is that normalized weighted convolution block and the prescribed symbol is Sτ,ik = Tifτ,ikT∗ k , then ∥Vτ,ik − Uτ,ik ⊗ Sτ,ik∥ ≤ η in the full regular operator norm, at every height. The tensor notation here means that each scalar incidence entry multiplies the same matrix-valued deck convolution symbol. 3. Weights are read from one finite set, independent of height. Appending their net indices to the existing edge labels preserves the labelled-graph uniqueness properties and gives log2 |A| ≤ 1.00005s + O(log s) + Ob,η,profiles(1) < log2(q2 ) for sufficiently large s. In particular p |A|/q tends to zero as s increases after the fixed data. Zero-weight edges are retained in the voltage cover.
